title: Accounting for Optimal Control in the Sizing of Isolated Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems Using Imitation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2601.03679v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Decarbonization of isolated or off-grid energy systems through phase-in of large shares of intermittent solar or wind generation requires co-installation of energy storage or continued use of existing fossil dispatchable power sources to balance supply and demand. The effective CO2 emission reduction depends on the relative capacity of the energy storage and renewable sources, the stochasticity of the renewable generation, and the control of the isolated energy system. While the operation of the energy storage and dispatchable sources impacts the optimal sizing of the system, it is challenging to account for the effect of finite-horizon optimal control at the stage of system sizing. In this work, we present a flexible and computationally efficient sizing framework for energy storage and renewable capacity in isolated energy systems, accounting for uncertainty in the renewable generation and the optimal control. translated_title: 基于模仿学习的孤立混合可再生能源系统容量配置中的最优控制考量
translated_abstract: 通过逐步引入大比例间歇性太阳能或风能发电来实现孤立（离网）能源系统的脱碳，需要同时配置储能设施或继续使用现有的化石燃料可调度电源来平衡供需。有效的二氧化碳减排取决于储能与可再生能源的相对容量、可再生能源发电的随机性以及孤立能源系统的控制策略。虽然储能和可调度电源的运行会影响系统的最优容量配置，但在系统容量配置阶段考虑有限时域最优控制的影响具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个灵活且计算高效的孤立能源系统储能与可再生能源容量配置框架，该框架同时考虑了可再生能源发电的不确定性和最优控制。我们实现了一个（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个基于模仿学习的容量配置框架，能够在孤立混合可再生能源系统的储能与可再生能源容量规划中，高效地纳入最优控制策略与可再生能源发电不确定性的影响。
